name: Sustainability Designer
tagline: Simulate a building's resource flows and get a live IGBC/LEED certification pre-assessment score.
description: Animates a building's energy, water, and waste resource flows between grid, PV, municipal supply, and landfill, and pre-assesses its IGBC and LEED certification scores live as the design changes.

page.objective: Show a green-building certification score early enough to still act on it, instead of at the end of design.
page.problem: IGBC/LEED pre-assessment is normally a point-in-time exercise, done once a design is mostly fixed.
page.solution: A resource-flow simulation and the IGBC/LEED score update together as the building's areas, occupancy, and systems change.

highlights.headline: Live resource-flow diagram paired with an IGBC/LEED score that updates with it.
points: Animates energy/water/waste ribbons flowing between grid, PV, municipal supply, and landfill.
Scores the design against IGBC and LEED certification live, side by side.
Exports the assessment as a structured .sud.json file.
